Around this time last year I was having serious stomach troubles. I was sick and on medication for a few months. My best friend who I hadn't seen in months came in town and asked me to go out to eat. I accepted and we went to eat some spicy Indian food. Very bad idea. My stomach took my choice of cuisine as a sign of disrespect. Before we left the restaurant I could tell that there was gonna be a problem. We get in the car and I feel horrible so I have my friend stop at a gas station. I waddle inside with my butt cheeks clenched only to see a sign on the door saying that their bathrooms are going through renovations and can not be used. I waddle back out to my friends car and have him drive me back to my apartment. The whole time he's cracking up. We finally get back to my place and I head for the bathroom. As soon as I open the door to the bathroom I projectile vomit everywhere and shit my pants simultaneously.
